cells into canonical adapter records and proves the prior 35-record prefix is
unchanged. Nevertheless, a publication bug can corrupt downstream science as
effectively as a bad sensor. BW24M-PROFILE already demonstrated that risk when
an inherited attempt cardinality consumed an identity even though its worker
computed the right table.

The corrected successor pattern therefore applies the same prospective rigor
to zero-world data transformation. The exact `38/39/49` profile, adapter-start,
and gate cardinalities are declared together; one constructor creates both
synthetic and real attempts; ten defects pass through the production parser;
the actual publication requires a matching full-conformance attestation and
the shared global mutex; and the attempt must exist before report generation.

This is not extra ceremony around a file write. It ensures that later BW28Y
cells cite one immutable mapping from authored material to controller input.
Without that mapping, a locomotion comparison could be internally
deterministic yet scientifically uninterpretable. With it, the next study can
hold material provenance identical across paired controller arms while still
making no claim beyond the exact published Godot/Jolt cells.

## 100. Historical verification must model time explicitly

The first closure-audit implementation failed closed with `SOURCE_BINDINGS`.
The retained V2 attestation was unchanged and its physical consumer had passed
the production verifier before BW27M opened a world. The audit defect was
temporal: it tried to validate the historical attestation by hashing today's
`run_conformance.ps1`, even though closing BW27M necessarily changes that file
from the prospective supervisor route to the immutable closure route.

The corrected audit preserves both source identities. It pins the exact raw
checkout hashes recorded in the sealed attestation, independently resolves the
normalized Git blobs from physical commit `a219ba86`, and re-hashes current
files whenever their normalized content is still the historical blob. The
mixed-line-ending historical runner retains its attested raw-byte digest and
its independently checked Git identity without pretending that current bytes
are historical bytes.

This is a useful negative infrastructure result: a verifier can be strict and
still ask the wrong historical question. The correct response is to preserve
the failed diagnostic, repair the verifier's model of time, and rerun the
audit. No exposed physical value, threshold, receipt, report, or scientific
classification was changed to obtain the passing closure.

## 101. Deterministic publication still needs prospective falsifiability

BW27P opens no physics worlds and exposes no new natural outcome, but a
deterministic registry transition can still fail scientifically important
infrastructure requirements. A source record may carry the wrong coefficient,
a real attempt may retain predecessor cardinalities, a closure digest may be
misbound, or an incomplete key set may be accepted by a forgiving parser.
Those defects can make later physical trials uninterpretable even though the
publication itself is computationally deterministic.

The prospective gate therefore tests the actual `38`-profile registry and
observes `39` adapter starts and `49` passing gates with zero worlds, samples,
or commands. It serializes a perfect attempt produced by the same constructor
used for retained publication and passes it through the production parser.
Ten independent one-field mutations cover profile cardinality, missing and
wrong adapter-start cardinality, gate cardinality, campaign and gate identity,
preregistration and both prerequisite closure digests, and unexpected fields.
Every mutation must fail closed.

The retained state transition remains unconsumed until a clean pushed commit
passes full Godot-including conformance and receives an exact-source durable
V2 attestation. Only then may the shared lock be acquired and `attempt.json`
be written before `report.json`. At the current freeze boundary the positive
statement is limited to gate satisfiability and adapter-table conformance.
`profile_published`, walking, turning, material robustness, continuous
friction coverage, cross-engine equivalence, arbitrary morphology, and SDK
completion all remain false.

This separation is valuable even when no physical observation occurs. It
prevents administrative success from being mistaken for empirical success,
and it ensures the later BW28Y experiment consumes a versioned, independently
auditable material input rather than an informal number copied from a report.
Seeds `27011–27014` remain sealed until publication closes positive.

## 102. A zero-world transformation can close positively without becoming physics evidence

BW27P passed its single retained publication attempt from clean pushed source
`e3a3c0b7`. The production table resolved and round-tripped all `38` profiles,
performed `39` adapter starts, and passed `49/49` gates. It intentionally
constructed `0` physics worlds and collected `0` locomotion samples or motor
commands. This is a positive result about provenance-preserving software
infrastructure: three empirically characterized BW27M cells now have exact,
immutable adapter records.

The distinction matters. The earlier BW27M worlds established finite
breakaway brackets for three exact Godot/Jolt fixtures. BW27P did not repeat
or enlarge that empirical domain; it transformed those retained values into
controller inputs `0.61/0.73/0.84` without silently changing identities,
coefficients, or claim scope. The SHA-hashed attempt, report, completion,
logs, source blobs, and full-conformance attestation make that transformation
independently reconstructable.

## 103. Lock contention is a useful negative result when it fails before identity consumption

Two processes reached the publication boundary, but only one held the global
operation mutex. The duplicate was refused before `attempt.json` existed and
therefore consumed no experimental identity; the successful process wrote
the only attempt before asking the worker for a report. The closure records
both facts explicitly. This is the correct treatment of concurrency: preserve
the observed refusal, prove it made no scientific state transition, and do
not pretend the rejected process was another experiment.

The resulting closure audit requires exactly one BW27P attempt anywhere in
the durable evidence tree, validates all eight files and the historical
full-Godot attestation, and proves the supervisor now fails closed on every
same-identity rerun. A positive administrative transition is thus held to the
same immutability standard as a physical campaign because later experiments
will rely on it.

## 104. BW28Y may now be designed, but not silently launched

The positive closure opens one narrow planning edge: a distinct 28-world
paired turning-development manifest may freeze around the exact published

world. BW28Y must first demonstrate that a perfect policy-relative synthetic

for Rapier and MuJoCo. BW27P therefore advances the research chain without

## 105. Freeze the next comparison before implementing its physical route

BW28Y's stage-zero documents now state the exact question while every outcome

three newly published material profiles? The answer may be the lower-yaw arm

That exact zero-world proof now passes. It executes the actual inherited

It preserves a walking-negative as complete, rejects a missing cohort and a

This is the reason to distinguish “can evaluate a perfect result” from “has a

## 106. A valid `NONE` result is successful inference, not a failed experiment

BW28Y ran once from exact clean pushed source `77b4ca34`, under the matching
full-Godot V2 attestation and shared operation lock. All `28` physical workers
returned complete receipts, no recovery attempt was needed, every cell-level
integrity gate passed, and the final evaluator accepted `50/50` declared
gates. The result is therefore a valid observation under the preregistered
decision rule rather than an infrastructure failure.

The lower yaw gain B walked in `9/12` candidate fixtures versus A's `7/12`,
with aggregate production-walking failures reduced from `5` to `3`. It
repaired four paired A failures but introduced two paired regressions. The
frozen selector required a strictly better aggregate vector *and* zero paired
regressions, so it returned `NONE`. That is exactly the outcome the method was
designed to permit: a locally promising parameter does not replace the
baseline when it is non-monotonic over the finite paired fixtures.

All eight candidate nonwalks and the one nonwalking material-matched control
failed only `bounded_lateral_drift`. Tilt, forward translation, native
actuation, mechanism identity, application identity, receipt structure, and
finite diagnostics remained valid. This narrows the next hypothesis toward
commanded heading/yaw tracking and lateral regulation. It does not prove that
lower gain is generally better, that the baseline is generally superior, or
that either arm turns robustly.

## 107. Optimization changes the next hypothesis, never the observed verdict

Scientific rigor does not forbid learning from a negative result. It forbids
changing the question after seeing the answer and then presenting the changed
question as prospective. BW28Y's result can therefore motivate intermediate
gains, direct heading-error control, another branch-free turning mechanism, or
a more diagnostic set of declared commands. Those candidates must be frozen
under a new identity with fresh unexposed material values and seeds before any
new outcome is observed.

The closure makes that boundary executable. It pins the `145`-file evidence
tree at SHA-256
`c98fed56a9597f1c250f50279663a1e471ef325f44ab72678a6d2ad77188cbf1`,
requires the single attempt ID `7a44427e656244358f8f774333eb2af5`,
reconstructs all `29` canonical source blobs from the physical commit, and
refuses another BW28Y physical invocation. It also preserves the exact raw
Windows-checkout hashes used by the prospective freeze while acknowledging
Git's configured line-ending normalization as a separate canonical
serialization. Hashes identify which code and artifacts were evaluated; they
do not by themselves turn a finite development screen into a population
claim.

BW28Y closes no product evidence gap by itself. It authorizes neither a new
walking policy nor turning, finite material robustness, continuous friction
coverage, arbitrary quadrupeds, cross-engine equivalence, or release. If a
scientifically distinct successor eventually selects a candidate, a fresh
independent validation cohort is still required before either turning or
bounded material-locomotion acceptance can become true.

an empty collection is a legitimate state must prove the exact production

failed `R23D13_QUIESCENT_TAPER`, so selector `NONE` kept all nine Stage B cells
closed. The exact closure remains
[`../sdk/turning/r23d13_physical_closure_v1.json`](../sdk/turning/r23d13_physical_closure_v1.json).
No new movement successor may be designed, frozen, or opened until the process
commissioning below is reviewed and completed.

### 111.1 Threshold provenance and estimand separation

The inherited `0.01 rad` tight tilt and `0.20 rad` joint-error thresholds were
not unrecorded aspirations. R23D10 placed them prospectively between the
retained R23D9 stable-arm window (`0.0046328185`, `0.1754098331`) and unstable-
arm window (`0.0239280476`, `0.2634916890`). This is disclosed, thin development
calibration from one fixture and two arms. It is not population calibration,
but it also may not be described as an unsupported guess.

Ordinary walking tilt is not automatically a valid calibration population for
a four-contact quiescent handoff followed by irreversible passive zero
actuation. A future threshold change requires a distinct prospective identity,
an explicit product meaning, a declared development-calibration set, and fresh
validation. It may not reclassify R23D10 through R23D13.

The post-closure read-only provenance query now makes that separation
executable in
[`../tests/test_terminal_handoff_threshold_provenance.ps1`](../tests/test_terminal_handoff_threshold_provenance.ps1).
It raw-rehashes the R23D10 declaration and the R23D12/R23D13 closures, verifies
both threshold values remain strictly between the disclosed stable and
unstable R23D9 windows, and confirms that the positive arms remain below both
limits while both negative arms remain above them. R23D13 improved the
negative-arm best tilt from `0.0203982793` to `0.0170804079 rad` and best joint
error from `0.2375508558` to `0.2079429633 rad`, but did not cross either frozen
limit and then lost contact on `43` passive steps. The controller/terminal-law
gap is therefore real for the declared passive-handoff endpoint.

The same audit independently rehashes the retained BW19V-B report and all
engine logs for its `33` finite Godot/Jolt walking-conjunction positives. Their
last sampled tilts range from `0.000000` to `0.001859 rad`, with median
`0.000772`; all `33/33` are at or below `0.01`. This does not convert BW19V into
passive-standing evidence, but it rejects the critique's narrower prediction
that accepted Godot walking routinely terminates above the turning limit.
Separate exact finite Rapier PH1 and MuJoCo MV6 positives do end their retained
traces at `0.0514967926` and `0.0580050319 rad`, respectively, but both use an
active pose-hold/restoration contract rather than R23D10's irreversible
zero-actuation handoff. They are evidence for a different endpoint, not a
calibration population for rewriting this one.

Accordingly, a next passive-handoff turning successor must retain `0.01` and
`0.20` and change a prospectively declared controller, terminal target, or
horizon mechanism. If the product instead needs active standing or controlled
settling, define and calibrate that as a distinct capability contract. No D14
identity, mechanism, or physical series is authorized by this review.

The retained R23D13 negative trace supplies design evidence, not a
counterfactual outcome. Across its final 120 active rows, all four contacts were
present while tilt decreased from `0.0204353485` to `0.0170804079 rad` and
joint error decreased from `0.2383445018` to `0.2079429633 rad`; the final row
was the best row. The expanded executable trace query now distinguishes the
leading mechanism. Positive first satisfied coarse and tight together at
active index `318`, so its next-step taper was well timed. Negative first
satisfied only coarse at index `339`, entered taper at `340`, never satisfied
tight, and did not receive floor-dominant residual authority until index `407`.
The existing temporal law therefore reduced negative-arm authority before it
had acquired the pose that authorizes a safe taper. This is more specific than
an uncalibrated gain or horizon hypothesis.

The first repeatable development candidate is therefore
`tight_gated_acquisition_v1`, implemented as a pure temporal oracle in
[`../sdk/turning/terminal_tight_first_development.py`](../sdk/turning/terminal_tight_first_development.py)
and an explicitly non-validating MuJoCo wrapper in
[`../sdk/adapters/mujoco/sporespore_mujoco_adapter/qsdk_turning_tight_first_development.py`](../sdk/adapters/mujoco/sporespore_mujoco_adapter/qsdk_turning_tight_first_development.py).
It preserves the thresholds, `540/120/360` horizons, complete inherited

candidate change is that acquisition remains at full authority until tight is

lost. This leaves the retained positive transition unchanged by construction
and targets the exact negative transition mismatch without arm identity or
heading sign.

The runner

### 111.2 Repeatable development and one-shot validation are different lanes

A repeatable development/calibration lane may inspect retained traces and run
outcome-visible CPU MuJoCo or NVIDIA MuJoCo Warp candidate screens. It must:

- carry explicit `development_only` authority and never satisfy a release gate;
- retain candidate, seed, morphology, environment, response, failure, and
  outcome identity;
- separate training/calibration data from held-out validation data;
- keep engine-neutral commands and refuse engine-specific hidden gait logic;
- label Warp feature coverage and never treat GPU throughput as native MuJoCo,
  Rapier, Godot/Jolt, transfer, population, or equivalence evidence; and
- promote only a frozen artifact and preregistered candidate into validation.

Load-bearing validation remains prospective and one-shot. It uses clean pushed
source, held-out declared cells, ordinary native engine paths, complete
zero-world gates, exact runtime bindings, source-exact attestation, locks,
content-addressed evidence, unchanged evaluators, and immutable closure. A
development winner is a hypothesis until that validation passes.

### 111.3 Conformance acceleration requires proof-preserving reuse

The post-R23D13 canonical no-Godot sweep took `1,754 s`. At that boundary,
`sdk/run_conformance.ps1` contained `142` PowerShell-test references and `88`
closure-audit references but no per-stage duration record. The total duration
does not identify the bottleneck. Historical closures may not be removed from
load-bearing qualification merely because the aggregate suite is slow.

Process commissioning must implement these gates before cached or scheduled
verification can replace an invocation:

1. Every conformance stage emits a compact machine-readable receipt containing
   stage identity, exact transitive input digest, toolchain/runtime identity,
   start/end/duration, bytes hashed where applicable, cache status, exit code,
   and retained full-log paths.
2. A reusable passing receipt is content-addressed over the audit blob, every
   declared helper/import, closure and evidence digests, relevant toolchain and
   host semantics, configuration, and result. Undeclared dependencies,
   ambiguity, missing bytes, changed environment semantics, or receipt
   corruption fail closed and force execution.
3. The fast development tier runs affected unit/integration tests only and has
   no physical or release authority.
4. The physical-authorization tier runs the active campaign lineage and full
   transitive dependency closure plus the global safety kernel: reproducible
   artifacts, operation lock, CAS/provenance integrity, worker/evaluator/
   supervisor negative controls, shared SDK/ABI invariants, and release-claim
   fail-closed checks.
5. The full cold tier executes every historical closure and release gate on a
   schedule, before release, after evidence/toolchain/host-semantic changes,
   and whenever impact analysis cannot prove a stage unaffected.
6. A previously passing receipt may be reused only when its complete key is
   exact. Cache hits remain independently digest-verified and appear in the
   final attestation; they are never silently skipped tests.
7. Successful stages print one concise receipt. Full stdout/stderr remains
   inspectable; failures print the failed stage, exact identities, a useful
   bounded excerpt, and the retained full-log path.

CEP1 remains necessary but is not a sufficient physical-authorization kernel.
It classifies how closure audits obtain evidence; it does not by itself prove
current builds, shared runtime behavior, complete transitive dependencies, or
release fail-closed semantics.

Until the instrumentation, receipt key, invalidation controls, safety kernel,
and one complete cold-baseline comparison pass executable negative controls,
the existing full source-exact conformance and attestation requirements remain
unchanged. Scheduled verification is the result of proven cache equivalence,
not a temporary waiver.

### 111.4 Required resumption order

The first resumed work is zero-world process commissioning, not a movement
successor:

1. add stage timing, compact receipts, and retained failure logs;
2. declare the transitive dependency and content-addressed receipt contract;
3. implement cache/invalidation mutation controls and the authorization safety
   kernel;
4. run one complete cold comparison establishing cached and executed receipt
   equivalence;
5. add a read-only retained-trace lineage analyzer for convergence, contacts,
   authority, support, and limiting actuators;
6. decide whether the next product question preserves the compound turn/stop/
   passive endpoint or separates those primitives; and
7. only then declare a development screen or physical successor.

Process commissioning opens zero physics worlds and changes no frozen campaign,
selector, threshold, result, evidence object, or release claim.

Every completed stage writes a create-only JSON observation, prints one compact

observed repository state, the runner/module/contract/artifact-store bytes,

digests, and the transcript's content-addressed copy.

This is instrumentation authority only. The receipt truthfully declares its

`disabled_uncommissioned`, lookup false, reuse false, cache authority false,
historical waiver false, and every scientific, physical, and release claim
false. The focused audit passes an eight-receipt success path plus wrong-order,

The next commissioning step remains the complete transitive dependency,
toolchain, host-semantics, closure, and evidence key. Until its mutation and
invalidation controls plus the authorization safety kernel and full cold
equivalence baseline pass, the new receipts cannot suppress even one existing

### 111.7 Conservative dependency-key candidate

Phase two begins with
[`../sdk/conformance_dependency_contract_v1.json`](../sdk/conformance_dependency_contract_v1.json),

The focused gate proves order and root invariance; content mutation; missing,

classification; and declared-runtime invalidation. The canonical runner
executes that gate in stage 1. Every production observation constructs its

synthetic construction failure is
retained as a failed stage and run rather than escaping before evidence exists.

One dirty-tree development probe inventoried `3136` tracked checkout files,

conservatively covered. Constant-flow resolution or explicit per-audit
declarations remain necessary to recover cross-session reuse without ignoring

CDK1 remains deliberately incomplete. Runtime closure, external evidence
closure, non-environment undeclared-input proof, per-audit manifests, the
authorization safety kernel, and Godot-inclusive executed-versus-reused
equivalence are still open.
The contract hard-codes lookup false, reuse false, and every scientific,
physical, historical-waiver, and release claim false. Existing conformance may
not skip anything because a candidate digest exists.

### 111.21 Campaign-local qualification is distinct from historical maintenance

The measured historical flat tax does not justify weakening evidence, but it
does justify removing unrelated history from a new campaign's critical path.
For a physical successor, the proportionate gate must execute its own immutable
lineage closures, the complete current CEP1 provenance inventory, the permanent
authorization safeguards, and its exact worker/evaluator/supervisor controls.
It must retain every failure and refuse physical execution on any failure.
Unrelated historical closures move to a scheduled, receipt-retaining regression
sweep; that sweep's failures remain real verifier or history defects and may
not be hidden by a passing campaign-local gate.

Attestation is a separate boundary. Until a narrower Godot-inclusive
attestation schema is prospectively declared, negative-controlled, and cold-
commissioned, existing physical launchers must continue consuming the full-
Godot V2 attestation they name. Thus campaign-local qualification is active for
R23D14, while replacement of the remaining broad attestation tax is future
infrastructure work rather than an implicit waiver.

A production-retention canary is incomplete when it proves only that bytes

## 159. Recovery success must be observable before it is controllable

A prone-to-standing controller can appear successful while relying on hidden
assistance or an engine-local label. Therefore the recovery evidence surface
must be frozen before controller development begins. At minimum, the contract
must define canonical entry and exit poses, post-step observation channels,
ordered phase transitions, contact and clearance semantics, exclusive
controller ownership at handoff, safety and timeout behavior, exact accounting
for root/world assistance, and a matched zero-command control.

The first recovery question is **non-physical source conformance**. It may
declare the complete design and prove claim-changing mutation refusal, but it
must set no physical threshold or cohort and cannot establish movement. The
next repeatable policy/tuning question is **development** and supplies no
acceptance or population claim. A later frozen all-engine conjunction is a
separate held-out **finite decision**. Equivalence or non-inferiority requires
its own margins, provenance, adequacy argument, and prospective cohort; it is
not implied by a finite conjunction.

Historical constrained get-up evidence may supply design priors only when its
fixture, guide, symmetry, engine, seeds, thresholds, and claim boundary remain
explicit. Numeric thresholds and cohorts cannot be inherited merely because a
previous constrained task passed. Every threshold and cohort used for a new
physical question needs its own provenance and adequacy argument before the
first world opens.

Missing physical observation capability is an explicit refusal, never an
invitation for an adapter to synthesize a channel or infer success from a host
pose label. Valid but unsupported morphology is OOD, unknown policy/profile is
unsupported, malformed or nonfinite input is invalid, and implicit fallback is
forbidden. These distinctions must remain executable through every adapter and
result schema.

QSDK-R24D1 applies this rule to exact s169. It declares `7` gate families,
`10` observations, `6` phases, `13` exact-zero no-cheat counters, `12` negative
controls, and `16` unset physical thresholds, then rejects `38` claim-changing
mutations with zero models or worlds. This advances design authority only;
prone-to-standing and QSDK-R24 remain false.

## 160. A native capability conjunction must preserve partial refusals

development. The portable core can classify and supervise a synthetic

`10/10`, a recovery failure, or evidence that another engine's measurement can

This result narrows the next non-physical question to Godot/Jolt post-solver
motor-effort and work observability. The alternative is a distinct prospective

threshold/cohort freezes, and clean-pushed adoption all pass, no development

## 161. Instrument motor work where each solver impulse is applied

An end-of-step motor impulse and two outer velocity samples are not generally a
source-separated actuator-work measurement in a sequential impulse solver.
Other limit, hinge, and contact impulses can change the generalized velocity
between motor iterations. A portable recovery ledger that ignores that
interleaving can attribute other constraints' work to the motor even when its
formula appears dimensionally correct.

QSDK-R24D3 therefore instruments the exact Jolt hinge-motor application site in
a distinct pinned Godot 4.7 profile. For each warm-start and iterative motor
delta it measures generalized hinge rate immediately before and after, records
`delta_lambda * average_rate`, and accumulates positive and absorbed energy
separately. It reads the final signed motor multiplier independently; configured
target/cap values and aggregate reaction magnitudes remain commands or mixed
reactions, never applied-effort substitutes.

The adequacy of source inspection, compilation, algebraic canaries, and twelve
mutation controls is deliberately narrow: these establish a source decision
and zero-world binding only. They do not establish native sign or numerical
accuracy. Before using the channel in recovery, one separately frozen
**development** hinge characterization must compare signed impulse with an
independent angular-momentum change and motor work with an independent kinetic-
energy change, exercise the cap, limits, disabled motor, invalid timing/RID, and
stale sequence, and retain its exact toolchain and evidence key.

The first clean-pushed cold R24D3 run is an explicit adequacy counterexample: it
passed compilation and the zero-world probe, but its receipt hashed only the
console launcher and retained neither launcher nor sibling engine executable.
That observation stays positive and immutable while qualification stays false.
The prospective successor requires both binaries to be copied, content-addressed,
and exercised from durable evidence before the result may be adopted. Post-hoc
hashing or copying is not an adequate repair of the consumed v1 receipt.

The clean-pushed v2 successor subsequently passed with both binaries retained
and executed from durable evidence, so the exact source compile/binding key is
adopted. Its binary hashes differ from the prior cold output; reproducible-build,
cold-equivalence, and result-reuse claims are therefore false. This adoption is
still zero-world source conformance, not the required one-hinge characterization.

The exact adoption source then passed all eight uncached canonical full-cold
conformance stages. The retained receipt, full log, stage receipts, CAS objects,
and full-Godot attestation are finitely qualified by
[`../sdk/recovery/r24d3_godot_jolt_motor_telemetry_post_adoption_full_cold_conformance_qualification_v1.json`](../sdk/recovery/r24d3_godot_jolt_motor_telemetry_post_adoption_full_cold_conformance_qualification_v1.json).
The run exercised stock Godot regression fixtures and did not execute the custom
instrumented runtime. It therefore completes the required conformance
prerequisite only; native sign, impulse, work, limit, disabled-motor, refusal,
and freshness remain unmeasured.

Stock and instrumented Godot profiles cannot substitute for one another. A
later supported instrumented profile still would not establish recovery,

## 166. R24D8 asks a finite timing question before numerical characterization

QSDK-R24D8 is **development** work, not finite-decision, superiority, or

The prospective mechanism places an immutable snapshot boundary in pinned
Godot/Jolt source. Jolt increments the native telemetry token only when an
active hinge receives velocity-constraint setup. `JoltSpace3D` increments its
own nonzero step token for every space step, captures a newly advanced native
receipt after `PhysicsSystem::Update` while `stepping` remains true, and exposes
that snapshot only after the step. This yields an exact treatment contrast:
four active steps must advance both native and capture tokens, while four steps
with the sole dynamic body deliberately sleeping must advance only the read
token and preserve the earlier snapshot.

question because they reject both a one-frame coincidence and a one-frame stale
read. They are not adequate to estimate impulse sign error, work/energy error,

population robustness. A zero target and zero external load deliberately keep
numerical magnitude outside the question.

The worker's step schedule follows pinned Godot ordering: `physics_frame`
precedes the server solve, so one initial boundary is consumed before sample
one; sleep is written after reading solve four and before solve five; and the
server is disabled after reading solve eight and before solve nine. The local
freeze proves these declarations and rejects 18 contract, 17 source, and 25

without their own derivative authority. Mechanical energy and residual are
not inputs, so the observer cannot close itself tautologically.

## 281. R24D70 contact-source adequacy diagnosis and R24D71 question

The immutable R70 raw result with SHA-256
`05081e6304d1023a98b5ed45b3701fa06b3a328677e0104c2323d033df8417ab`
contains enough retained state for a read-only whole-system vertical-momentum
check. With exact morphology mass `4.72 kg`, post-step COM velocity, observed
gravity, and outer-step duration, required external vertical impulse is
`m * (v_y[n] - v_y[n-1]) - m * g_y * dt`. Reported impulse is the disjoint sum
of four foot-bearing values and all foot-cap-excluded nonfoot normal values.

Across 263 candidate steps, mean absolute difference is
`0.300081656048204 N s` and maximum absolute difference is
`0.589674181820204 N s`. All four feet are ordinary contacts on 74 steps; that
subset's mean absolute difference is `0.339046034014276 N s`. At semantic step
127, the reconstruction requires about `0.4797522 N s` while the complete
reported normal population sums to about `0.06041075 N s`. The matched-zero
arm's static regime requires about `0.38547 N s` and reports about
`0.32783 N s`. These are deterministic diagnostics of the observed trace, not
new physical invocations or a replacement evaluator.

The causal adequacy argument combines that trace with primary engine sources.
Godot 4.7 says its Jolt impulse is a pre-solve estimate and limits accuracy to
body pairs whose members have no simultaneous other collisions. R70's one
floor and articulated nine-body support population do not satisfy that
condition. Pinned source `5b4e0cb0fd279832bbdd69fed5354d4e5ad26f88`
calls `EstimateCollisionResponse` for the public contact report. The vendored

completed solver step. `E` is the coherent completed boundary after the
kick-effect solve, retained across all nine bodies. `L = G - E` is the local
step supplied to the recovery policy and ledger. Full live translational,
rotational, and potential energy at `E` initializes that ledger. The kick is
excluded from recovery work and remains independently visible in its native
interaction receipt. Global callback and native-sequence facts remain global;
only versioned recovery-local counts restart.

and a kick/passive-recovery/resume arm. Its maximum active horizon is 3,841

## 406. R10F-L7 makes the missing terminal source independently falsifiable

L7 implements an observation boundary, not a recovery-policy repair. At the
last completed shared precondition frame it snapshots both arms. Each snapshot

handling runs before the generic post-release terminal-pair rule. Complete
continues to mean only “this arm supplied its own L6 standing source.” Failed
or refused stops the route without requiring the peer to fail on the same frame
and without advancing either world again. The peer's latest completed state is
retained. No terminal is promoted to success or behavioral failure, and no
missing value is inferred from the later outcome.

baseline failures, refusal, peer-state retention, and unchanged common release.

disposition, missing or contradictory failure codes, copied/stale nested data,
digest and readiness mismatches, outcome-derived correction, the generic
lockstep label, an extra post-failure step, and summary-only closure. The future
closer separately exercises four report classes and rejects 45 mutations.

## 433. Post-L15 fast development lanes preserve official acceptance

This prospective workflow follows the consumed L15 attempt and its distinct
[integrity-failure closure](../sdk/qsdk_r10f_l15_retained_integrity_failure_closure_v1.json).
The current [implementation and measured receipt](ENGINE_NEUTRAL_LOCOMOTION_SDK_BOOTSTRAP.md#fast-development-layer-one-exact-publication-and-real-interface-checks)
provide a zero-world real-interface gate, not a physical-smoke result.

Cole approved real-interface checks followed by bounded native diagnostic smoke
and targeted iteration. The complete **applicable** zero-world safety gate and
negative controls must cover each smoke's actual launch, construction, stepping,
reader, retention and no-claim publication paths before it opens a world.
Historical official qualification is not repurposed as the inner loop. These
separate diagnostic attempts may use an exactly bound owned development
snapshot, without an official freeze/authorization campaign; source stability,
runtime identity, operation locking, fresh attempt identities and retained
original diagnostics remain mandatory. Missing coverage fails closed.

Declare the smallest coverage-adequate seed/role/step/time population and every
omitted path before execution. A partial schedule proves only the exercised
diagnostic path, not complete recovery, an official route ghost, or support.
Never cache the no-kick child, erase a failed attempt, retry a consumed identity,
or turn development data into held-out evidence. Shared contracts should remove
hand-copied interface assumptions; telemetry changes require measurement and
must not alter solver inputs, simulated time, or official capture by implication.

Official qualification, complete dependency-key reuse rules, clean pushed
prospective validation, unchanged evaluators/thresholds, held-out separation,
independent evidence audits and release gates remain unchanged. This adds a
diagnostic physical lane to section 111.3's zero-world fast tier; it does not
claim cache equivalence or weaken the official physical-authorization tier.
The operational rules are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md#approved-fast-development-loop).
The bounded smoke runner and its safety gate must still be implemented and
tested; this prose is not execution evidence or a score change.

Subsequent execution is recorded separately in the
[first bounded physical-smoke checkpoint](ENGINE_NEUTRAL_LOCOMOTION_SDK_BOOTSTRAP.md#first-bounded-physical-smoke-retained-diagnostic-path-passes):
the implemented runner passed its 28-test safety gate and two fresh diagnostic
children, with exact retained publication. Its measured 878.651-second invocation
and partial post-kick coverage are development facts only. No complete-route,
recovery, equivalence, acceptance or score claim follows from that smoke.
